lines.text: A Pharisee invited Jesus to dine, and he was surprised that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.
Jesus said the Pharisees were full of fear and wickedness inside, though they cleaned the outside of the cup and dish.
Jesus pronounced woes on the Pharisees for loving the chief seats in the synagogues and being like unmarked graves.
Jesus told the experts in the law they built tombs for the prophets, but their fathers had killed them.
Jesus said this generation would be charged with the blood of the prophets, from Abel to Isaiah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary.
